limitations: Session tests execute real shell orchestration with modeled iw/ip/module/child commands; they do not exercise Android netdev/module loading or firmware. Existing pure protocol and WMA submission model tests run under ASan/UBSan. New relay dispatch and scripts have host/model and Android build validation only. Requires existing UP native TX interface on requested channel, matching mac80211/Wonder, native monitor support and patched opt-in WLAN for RAW. Monitor set acceptance is recorded separately from optional readback and does not certify RF frequency. Sequential TX relay is not AWDL timing, independent NDI/backend init, dynamic channel/DBS, mac80211 TX-status feedback or phone interoperability.
